text:
Type: arched window pane wall mirror
Use: decorating a wall, reflecting light; living room, bedroom, dining room, on a wall
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: distressed metal frame in silver finish, rust-toned corner brackets, mirror glass
Colors: weathered silver grey, rust orange accents
Shape: tall Gothic pointed arch, window-like grid of small side panes and large central pane, open and airy
Feel: romantic, vintage, airy
Goes with: whitewashed wood, linen, grey or cream walls; farmhouse or cottage rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Arc Metal Frame Hanging Wall Mirror Decor, 46.25 Inch Height, Silver Finish
product.description: Sweeping metal shapes form a design suggesting a cathedral window. The metal frame has a distressed-look silver finish that artfully combines elements of antique, modern and even rustic design. Modern and antique influences with touch of glam Glass, iron with silver finish 18.25"W x 1"D x 46.25"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
